signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 3 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: * 1 credit is charged for all the contact details of one person.
You only get to save 500 at a time and each list can only be 5,000 results.
the max to download is only 500 page.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (0.8% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I also attempted to contact support using the email address that sent my login PIN, but my email was returned as invalid.
The "support team" will just drag you along telling you they are fixing it
Despite reaching out to customer service multiple times over several months, the responses have been inconsistent.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2/5 vs 4.45/5 all-time (-2.45). 12% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $89 tier lacks 3 of 4 features in the $178 tier.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 4.4 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $89 vs a stated $1656 regular price (95% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.
We may modify the Agreement from time to time. Any amended terms automatically take effect ten (10) days following being posted on the Website.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased LeadRocks - Plus exclusive can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: The vendor states AppSumo buyers can add more credits by purchasing extra AppSumo codes, directly supporting buying more codes to increase limits, with no exhibit undercutting it.

exhibits.quote: You can add more credits by purchasing extra AppSumo codes on our deal page.
exhibits.argument: This official vendor text confirms AppSumo buyers can purchase extra codes to add more credits.

trials.claim: One Plus Exclusive code provides 7,500 search credits vs 5,000 in regular deal
trials.claimQuote: In the LeadRocks deal, one code grants 5,000 search credits, while in the LeadRocks Plus Exclusive deal, one code provides 7,500 search credits.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about 7,500 versus 5,000 credits per code.

trials.claim: Seller promises 100M+ record B2B database with emails, phones and LinkedIns
trials.claimQuote: LeadRocks is a reliable B2B contact database with 100M+ records, emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIns
trials.reasoning: Reviews show most leads lacked phone numbers or had wrong ones and few emails survived verification, materially undercutting the promise of a reliable 100M+ database with emails, phones and LinkedIns. The defense exhibit only repeats the seller's promise, it does not show it was delivered.

exhibits.quote: Then I verified the remaining emails with Reoon and I had 389 leads left.
exhibits.argument: Shows only a tiny fraction of pulled contacts were valid, undermining the reliable 100M+ database promise.

exhibits.quote: most of the leads have no phone number. In other the phone is wrong
exhibits.argument: Shows phone numbers are missing or wrong, undermining the promise of phones included.

exhibits.quote: Your system boasts 100M records, emails and phone numbers and you cannot FIND ONE EMAIL OUT OF 700 leads?????
exhibits.argument: The buyer repeats the seller promise of 100M records with emails and phone numbers.

trials.claim: No API integrations for data export
trials.claimQuote: Currently, LeadRocks does not offer API integrations for data export.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm there is no API for pulling or exporting leads and that only the Email Verifier tool is available. The prosecution exhibit is about a verification API, not a data-export API, so it does not contradict this claim.

exhibits.quote: Keep your email lists clean and valid with LeadRocks bulk email verification or via API.
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises verification via API, contradicting the claim that no API is offered.

exhibits.quote: If there were an API for pulling the leads I could automate this whole thing, but there isn't.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms there is no API available for pulling leads for export.

exhibits.quote: Drawbacks: API is lacking. Only the Email Verifier tool is available.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms API is lacking except for the Email Verifier tool.

trials.claim: API can be used to verify emails on Email Verifier tab
trials.claimQuote: However, you can use the API to verify emails on the Email Verifier tab.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say the Email Verifier returns every email as unknown and the verification widget is no longer functioning, materially limiting the claim that the API can be used to verify emails.

exhibits.quote: On that note, the Email Verifier yields every email as unknown status.
exhibits.argument: Shows the Email Verifier returns only unknown, undermining that API verification works.

exhibits.quote: The verification widget is no longer functioning - we have to pass 2-3 times on some occasions.
exhibits.argument: Shows verification is not functioning reliably, undermining the verification claim.

exhibits.quote: Keep your email lists clean and valid with LeadRocks bulk email verification or via API.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states email verification can be done via API.

exhibits.quote: Drawbacks: API is lacking. Only the Email Verifier tool is available.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the only API available is for the Email Verifier tool.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let LeadRocks modify or discontinue the platform and change the agreement at any time, which undercuts a guarantee that previous customers will be grandfathered into new feature limits.

exhibits.quote: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.
exhibits.argument: Lets vendor modify or discontinue features at any time, voiding any grandfathering promise.

exhibits.quote: We may modify the Agreement from time to time.
exhibits.argument: Allows unilateral changes to terms, undermining a permanent grandfathered limits guarantee.

Sometimes bad emails are as high as 80%.
we have not been working for that company for past 8 years

my account only showing 50 monthly credits instead of what I expected
Of the 17,775 RI business owners I downloaded, only 56 were in RI.
they do not allow you to search for leads unless you have the company website.
95 out of 100 companies not found.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support stopped replying, gave invalid contacts, or failed to fix issues.

themes.summary: A few buyers say support was fast, reached out to fix login issues, and offered live help.

hits.quote: i will appreciate their support team because whenever i asked something i got a very fast response

hits.quote: The leads are accurate, easy to grab, and simple to organize within the app.
It is fast to fetch results, generous with the data/searches.
There are real leads here and a lot of them.

the max to download is only 500 page.
